_comment: Copy this file to org_config.json and fill in your real values before running build_837.py. Do not commit org_config.json anywhere shared -- it identifies your organization on every claim.
receiver_name: REPLACE WITH YOUR INTERNAL SYSTEM'S NAME
_usage_indicator_note: T = test data, P = production. Leave as T until your internal system's owner confirms real files should start flowing -- switching this is the signal that these are no longer test transactions.
_claim_filing_indicator_note: X12 code list 1032 (SBR09). 'ZZ' (Mutually Defined) is a safe placeholder, not a real answer -- pick the value your internal system actually expects, e.g. '11' Other Non-Federal Programs, 'CI' Commercial Insurance, 'CH' Champus, etc. See README.
_payer_note: This pipeline is single-payer by design (see x12_837.py's own SCOPE note) -- the same payer on every claim it builds, not something extracted per claim. Address is optional -- most 837 consumers don't need the payer's own mailing address, only its name/ID -- leave blank if yours doesn't ask for it.
